rationale: Exercise the already-implemented generic waiting-period certification, publication authorization, authoritative materialization, frozen artifact persistence, and coverage-registry-backed published evidence lookup using Star PED governed data only. No governed runtime implementation is added or modified. The pressure test includes a semantic perturbation control that removes the continuity component from the publication projection while leaving certified evidence unchanged.
supersession_impact: No capability, implementation, or historical artifact is superseded. The standard PED binding and certification remain immutable; this change only supplies publication-governance data and tests reuse of existing authorities.
authority_impact: No authority is broadened. Publication remains bounded to explicitly certified semantic components and explicit boundary authorization. Customer-specific PED buy-back selection, customer eligibility, and claim-payment determination remain unauthorized.
